places.name: Umiam Lake (Barapani)
places.description: The largest and most scenic lake in Northeast India, offering watersports in a stunning highland pine-forest setting.
places.bestTime: October to March for clear skies; morning for mist

places.name: Don Bosco Centre for Indigenous Cultures
places.description: The definitive introduction to the staggering ethnic diversity of Northeast India, with world-class curation.
places.mapsSearch: Don Bosco Centre Indigenous Cultures Shillong

places.name: Elephant Falls
places.description: The accessibility of three waterfall stages in a single lush forest walk makes this the ideal introduction to Meghalaya's cascades.
places.bestTime: June to October for maximum flow; October to January for clearer viewing

places.name: Shillong Peak
places.description: The highest and most comprehensive panoramic viewpoint of Shillong and the surrounding Khasi Hills.
places.bestTime: October to December for clearest visibility

places.name: Ward's Lake
places.description: A perfectly preserved piece of British colonial urban landscape design that still functions as Shillong's most beloved park.
places.bestTime: Morning or late afternoon; October to March

places.name: Dawki and Umngot River
places.description: The crystal-clear floating-boat illusion of the Umngot River is one of India's most visually extraordinary natural phenomena.
places.bestTime: October to March for maximum clarity; monsoon turns the river turbid

places.name: Mawlynnong Village
places.description: The contrast between Mawlynnong's obsessively maintained cleanliness and rural India's typical disorder is genuinely astonishing.
places.mapsSearch: Mawlynnong Village Meghalaya Asia Cleanest Village

places.name: Laitlum Canyons
places.description: The most dramatic canyon viewpoint in Meghalaya, where the Khasi Hills literally end at a 600-metre cliff edge.
places.bestTime: October to December for clear visibility; monsoon for cloud drama

places.name: Spread Eagle Falls (Bishop and Beadon Falls)
places.description: Two parallel waterfalls viewed together from a single vantage is a rare and scenic waterfall encounter close to the city.
places.bestTime: June to November during and just after monsoon

places.name: Khasi Heritage Village (Smit)
places.description: The November Nongkrem Dance is the most elaborately costumed and culturally significant festival in Meghalaya.
places.mapsSearch: Smit Khasi Heritage Village Nongkrem Shillong
places.bestTime: November (5 days of Nongkrem festival); otherwise October to March
